name: Coup

categories.label: Last player with influence (win)
categories.hint: Tick for the sole surviving player

winCondition: Eliminate the influence of all other players; the last player with at least one face-down influence card wins. There is no second place.

endCondition.description: Game ends when only one player still has an unrevealed influence card

notes: family: elimination. No points. Each player starts with 2 influence cards and 2 coins (2-player: starting player gets 1 coin). Rulebook text read via a rules transcription site, not the publisher PDF; Reformation/Rebellion/Anarchy variants not modelled.
